==Notes==
* This skill is mechanically the same as a [[shadow step]].
* This skill is the only shadow step skill without a recharge time.

== Trivia ==
* During early alpha, Necrotic Traversal teleported the user to a targeted corpse, after which the corpse was exploited. It did not have any other effects. The skill type was "Necromancer Corpse Exploitation Skills" and used to cost 15 energy.
